series.title: Voice basics
series.summary: Breath, onset, and why tension migrates to the throat.

articles.title: Clean onset
articles.body:
A clean onset starts tone with the breath already moving. Glottal attacks and breathy leaks are the two common extremes.

Practice easy vowels on a gentle sigh-to-tone. If the throat grabs, reduce volume and restart softer.

articles.title: Where tension hides
articles.body:
Jaw, tongue root, and shoulders steal resonance. Scan those three before you “push more support.”

Often the fix is release, not more effort.

series.title: Practice sense
series.summary: How to structure short sessions that compound.

articles.title: Short sessions win
articles.body:
Twenty focused minutes beat an unfocused hour. Warm, work one target, cool down.

Stop while quality is still rising.
